answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 19054 Country: United States of America Title: salaam. i was wondering if it would be permissible to eat food cooked in wine because when it reaches a certain tempereture, the alcohol content evaporates and would not actually be present in the food when you eat it? Question: salaam. i was wondering if it would be permissible to eat food cooked in wine because when it reaches a certain tempereture, the alcohol content evaporates and would not actually be present in the food when you eat it? Answer ID: 19054 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 152/138/D=1431) Eating food cooked in wine is not allowed, for when wine was mixed in food it got impure. Now it cannot be pure. And it is not right to say that after reaching a certain temperature its contents evaporate hence it should be lawful; because due to cooking food in wine its impurity became stable and now it cannot be removed. إذا صب الطباخ في القدر مكان الخل خمرا غلطا فالكل نجس لا يطهر أبدا . (الهندية: ج:1/ص:27) والطبخ لا يؤثر فيها لأنه للمنع من ثبوة الحرمة لا لرفعها بعد تبوتها. (شامي:ج:2/ص:29) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
